CLASS SHAPES LIFE OUTCOMES PROFOUNDLY, THOUGH NATIONALITY, RACE, AND OTHER IDENTITIES ALSO STRUCTURE OPPORTUNITY AND EXPERIENCE IN SIGNIFICANT WAYS.
